pages.quiz:
HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Careers in Home Management 3.0 Cl and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Child Health Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Clothing Construction P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. D — newton (N)

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

6. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

10. B — Producers

11. C — Ice melting to water

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Careers in Home Management 3.0 Cl; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Maternal Health care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Child Health Care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Careers in Home Management 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Clothing Construction P; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
